findings.title: Circularity and Author-Coupled Rule Architecture
findings.evidence: app/orchestrator/prioritizer.py:32-36 defines categories 'internship', 'academic', 'otp' with fixed weights (+4, +2, -3) that map 1-to-1 to categories in eval/build_dataset.py. Ablation shows dropping categories drops nDCG@5 by 0.038.
findings.fix: Disclose author coupling in Threats to Validity. Re-test on held-out scenarios authored by an independent student annotator blind to prioritizer rules.

findings.title: Train/Test Data Contamination in Deployed LearnedRanker
findings.evidence: app/intelligence/train.py:79-92 fits ridge regression on all 40 scenarios in dataset.json and commits weights to ranker_weights.json. eval/run_eval.py uses LOSO, but deployed model is trained on evaluation data.
findings.fix: Re-train ranker_weights.json on a distinct partition (e.g. 50% split) or document that ranker_weights.json is an in-sample artifact, reporting only LOSO results in papers.

findings.title: Strawman Aspect of due_date Baseline and Tie-Breaking Variance
findings.evidence: eval/rankers.py:33 sorts items solely by due date, falling back to arrival order for ties and undated items. Adding a 2-line noise sink narrows the prioritizer gap from +0.067 to +0.047. Across 30 arrival seeds, due_date nDCG@5 fluctuates with std=0.019 (range [0.847, 0.916]).
findings.fix: Report stronger baselines (due_date + noise filter and hybrid kind tiebreak) alongside naive due_date in paper results tables.

findings.title: Single-Annotator Subjectivity and Unfilled Agreement Template
findings.evidence: eval/build_dataset.py was authored by one person. eval/annotator_agreement.py exits with 'No grades found yet' because study_kit/annotator_sheet.xlsx is unrated. However, 1000-trial Monte Carlo noise simulation shows prioritizer beats due_date in 100% of trials at 20% label noise.
findings.fix: Collect ratings from at least one independent annotator using the existing study_kit sheet and report Cohen's kappa.

findings.title: Trivial Security Benchmark and 100% Adaptive Attack Sanitizer Bypass
findings.evidence: eval/security_eval.py tests only 10 hand-authored attacks designed to match app/security.py regexes. verification/audit_security.py showed 10 of 10 adaptive injection attacks bypass the filter. app/orchestrator/llm.py:78-83 fails to sanitize metadata fields (due, kind, source). The proposed adversarial ranking benchmark does not exist in code.
findings.fix: Do not claim prompt injection robustness based on security_eval.py. Position adversarial ranking and briefing integrity as Future Work or implement the full benchmark.

findings.title: Metric Saturation on Short Scenarios
findings.evidence: verification/audit_metrics.py showed 20 of 40 scenarios (50.0%) contain 5 or fewer items, artificially elevating nDCG@5 floors (random baseline scores 0.739).
findings.fix: Report nDCG@3 as the primary retrieval metric alongside nDCG@5, and highlight scenario item distribution.

findings.title: MRR Metric Suppression from Missing Grade-3 Targets
findings.evidence: 13 of 40 scenarios (32.5%) have no grade-3 items. For these scenarios, MRR defaults to 0.0 for every ranker.
findings.fix: Define MRR conditionally on scenarios containing at least one grade-3 item, or report MRR@threshold=2.0.

findings.title: Undisclosed Linear DCG Gain Formulation
findings.evidence: eval/metrics.py:23 implements dcg as sum(rel_i / log2(i + 1)), whereas standard modern IR uses exponential gain (2^rel - 1). Under exponential gain, prioritizer delta is +0.084 instead of +0.067.
findings.fix: Explicitly state the linear gain formula in the methodology section, and report exponential gain in an appendix.

findings.title: Documentation vs Code Directory Drift
findings.evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md line 29 states prioritizer.py and ranking.py are in app/intelligence/. They are actually in app/orchestrator/. EVALUATION.md omits LearnedRanker.
findings.fix: Update ARCHITECTURE.md and EVALUATION.md to match the active codebase layout.

findings.title: Windows Console Unicode Crash and Missing Dependencies
findings.evidence: eval/run_eval.py line 219 crashes with UnicodeEncodeError on Windows CP1252 consoles due to '\u0394'. eval/annotator_agreement.py fails due to unlisted openpyxl dependency.
findings.fix: Add openpyxl to requirements.txt, and configure UTF-8 output encoding in run_eval.py.
